subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should shared reply-session code own persistent conflict recovery while Discord keeps this bounded abort-aware retry as defense in depth?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 recover the same initialization conflict at different layers; code correctness alone cannot choose the permanent lifecycle and replay policy.

options.title: Shared recovery plus Discord defense
options.body: Make shared session self-healing canonical and keep this bounded Discord retry for short transient races and replay release.

options.title: Discord-only recovery
options.body: Land the channel-specific policy and decline the shared self-heal, accepting per-channel recovery ownership and possible sibling drift.

options.title: Pause for shared recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until the shared proposal lands, then reassess whether Discord still needs a separate bounded retry.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery plus Discord defense
recommendation.body: Make shared session self-healing canonical and keep this bounded Discord retry for short transient races and replay release.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the current assignee and has recent history in both the Discord handler and adjacent session-lifecycle decisions.
